customer.business: The Aldera: magnesium in single-serve capsule sachets (pure bisglycinate and a 3-form complex)
customer.target: US women and men 24-45 who buy supplements on TikTok Shop after creator videos about sleep, stress, magnesium and wellness routines

segments.name: Urban professional woman with a busy day outside home

behaviours.name: Impulse buyer from creator videos
behaviours.how: Buys from the orange cart when a creator's video hits a problem you have, rarely compares.

behaviours.name: Already takes a multi-form complex
behaviours.how: Takes Toplux 8-forms or a 12-in-1 bought in a flash sale for about $15 and reorders when it runs out.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Waits for flash sales and coupons, compares price per day.

behaviours.name: Reads the label
behaviours.how: Checks elemental dose, forms, oxide, third-party testing before buying.

behaviours.name: On-the-go routine person
behaviours.how: Lives out of a tote bag, forgets pills at home, travels or sleeps away from home often.

behaviours.name: Skeptic of supplements
behaviours.how: Thinks most supplements are marketing unless there is proof.

behaviours.name: Hates swallowing pills
behaviours.how: Prefers gummies or drink mixes, big capsules are a dealbreaker.

pitch:
The Aldera magnesium, a new brand you see in a creator's video on TikTok Shop (US).
Two products, same format and same price: $29.99 for a box of 30 sealed single-serve foil sachets, 2 vegan capsules in each (one sachet a day, 30 days), free shipping.
1) Magnesium Bisglycinate: 200 mg elemental magnesium per sachet (100 mg per capsule), fully chelated, no magnesium oxide.
2) Magnesium Complex, 3 forms: bisglycinate 60 mg + malate 75 mg + citrate 72 mg = 207 mg elemental magnesium per sachet, no oxide.
Every batch is tested by a named independent ISO 17025 lab (magnesium content, heavy metals, microbes); a QR code on the box and on every sachet opens that batch report.
Look: a plum (Bisglycinate) or copper (Complex) soft-touch box that slides open like a cosmetics drawer, 30 sachets in two rows. The front says Magnesium, 200 mg, 30 sachets, "Every batch lab-tested" with a QR. Sachets are pocket-sized (about 1.8 x 2.6 in) and tear open with one hand. Brand line: "Self-care with somewhere to be."
When you answer, start your "reason" with one word: PURE, COMPLEX, BOTH or NONE (what you would buy), then say what on the box or sachet you noticed first.
